primitives.name: Closing Line Value
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Academic Deep-Research Report — Sports Forecasting & Betting ## (a) Sports Betting Market Efficiency / Closing Line Value (CLV) - **Ramesh, Mostofa, Bornstein, Dobelman (2019)** — arXiv:1910.08858 [econ.GN], *Beating the House: Identifying Inefficiencies in Sports Betting Markets*.
primitives.assumptions: Market prices reflect rational expectations; closing lines are accurate estimates of outcome probabilities.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When market efficiency holds, CLV ≈ 0; deviation indicates arbitrage opportunity.

layer2.mapping: CLV = p_closing - p_bet serves as a signal for betting strategy in GSE's decision engine.
layer2.telemetry: Aggregate CLV across bets to measure market inefficiency.

primitives.name: Anytime-Valid Inference
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## (b) Anytime-Valid / E-Value / Game-Theoretic Statistics - **Waudby-Smith & Ramdas (2022/2024)** — *Estimating Means of Bounded Random Variables by Betting* (arXiv:2412.21125; Annals of Statistics 2024).
primitives.assumptions: Observations are bounded; betting strategy adheres to coin-betting protocol.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When optional stopping occurs, e-values maintain validity without p-hacking.

layer2.mapping: E-processes in GSI provide anytime-valid confidence sequences for probabilistic forecasts.
layer2.telemetry: E-value thresholds for statistical significance in real-time betting decisions.

primitives.name: Conformal Forecast Sets
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## (c) Conformal Prediction for Sports Forecasts - **Cresswell, Sui, Kumar, Vouitsis (2024)** — arXiv:2401.13744 [cs.LG] (ICML 2024), *Conformal Prediction Sets Improve Human Decision Making*.
primitives.assumptions: Data is exchangeable; prediction scores are well-calibrated.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When prediction sets become too wide, coverage drops below nominal levels.

layer2.mapping: Conformal sets in GSE define uncertainty regions for betting outcomes.
layer2.telemetry: Coverage error rate of prediction sets against actual outcomes.

reasoning_traces.think:
The CLV primitive measures inefficiency between closing-line probability and estimated fair probability, enabling EV-based betting strategies. It operates under the assumption that markets are not perfectly efficient, allowing for arbitrage opportunities. The anytime-valid inference primitive uses coin-betting to generate e-values that remain valid even under optional stopping, ensuring statistical rigor in sequential decision-making. Conformal prediction provides valid prediction sets for outcomes, offering calibrated uncertainty bounds essential for risk-aware betting. These primitives form a layered system where CLV identifies exploitable inefficiencies, anytime-valid inference ensures robustness in real-time decisions, and conformal sets offer calibrated uncertainty quantification. Dualities emerge in how CLV and e-values both quantify deviation from expected behavior, while conformal sets provide a structured way to bound such deviations. Failure modes include overfitting in CLV estimation, invalidity under non-iid data in anytime-valid inference, and loss of coverage in conformal prediction due to poor score calibration.
